essence: The text introduces a protective armor called Trailokya-vijaya that is constituted of weapons, missiles, and mantra.
Wearing the Trailokya-vijaya armor empowered Madhusūdana to destroy all demons.
The armor's power is affirmed by association with Kubera and Vāsava.
The armor must never be transmitted to outsiders or unqualified practitioners.
Dakṣiṇāmūrti is the seer of this Bhairavī armor.
